summary: Validated Shop page performance optimizations (backend payload trimming + client-side filtering with module cache). Backend: 7/7 pytest passed. Frontend: instant filter switching (VO 11, VF 2, Tout 13, Deadpool 1), instant text search, and cached back-navigation (no refetch) all confirmed. No console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Shop.jsx uses a module-level cache that never invalidates during session — if admin edits/adds/deletes products while a user browses, the shop grid will show stale data until reload. Acceptable for a public catalog with rare updates, but consider a lightweight TTL (e.g., 60s) or an admin-triggered bust.
server.py list_products still to_list(5000); combined with cache-once-per-session on the frontend, catalog growth beyond 5000 will silently truncate the client cache.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Perf test suite at /app/backend/tests/test_shop_perf.py verifies (1) list payload excludes description/description_en/description_es, (2) list has all 13 required keys, (3) detail keeps description fields, (4) backend filters category/series/q still work. Frontend Shop uses module-level PRODUCTS_CACHE/SERIES_CACHE (Shop.jsx lines 7-9); confirmed no /api/products list refetch after product-detail round-trip. All filter data-testids: search-input, filter-cat-Tout|VO|VF, filter-series-{name}.
rca of the issue: N/A — feature verified working as specified.
